title: cadetia fluctuosa
intro: Cadetia fluctuosa, commonly known as the "Purple Passion Flower", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cadetia fluctuosa include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to calm the nervous system and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
